Redesign Agent and Tag Library

Use the claude_design MCP (https://api.anthropic.com/v1/design/mcp, auth via /design-login) to import this project:
https://claude.ai/design/p/0ca33cd3-c2fa-4644-b728-bde42292abbd?file=Libraries.html

Focus on these files (the whole project is readable):
- `Libraries.html`

Also read these files the selection imports:
- `variants/almanac.jsx`
- `variants/config-kit.jsx`
- `variants/libraries.jsx`
- `variants/shared.jsx`

Implement: `Libraries.html`

Implemented the Agent/Tag Library redesign from the Claude Design mock (`Libraries.html` + `variants/libraries.jsx`/`config-kit.jsx`/`shared.jsx`), adapted to this app's real architecture and Tailwind design tokens rather than pixel-matched to the mock's separate "Almanac paper" theme.

**Agent Library — full CRUD, backed by real files:**
- `src/main/agentLibrary.cjs`: added `savePersona` (writes `~/.claude/agents/<name>.md` frontmatter+body, handles renames), `deletePersona`, `removeOverride` (drops a project's local overlay), plus surfaced `model`/`color` frontmatter fields in `listPersonas`.
- New IPC (`agents:save-persona`, `agents:delete-persona`, `agents:remove-override`) wired through `index.cjs` → preload → `api.d.ts`.
- `AgentLibrary.tsx` rewritten as a real editor: New/Duplicate/Save/Revert/Delete-with-confirm, editable name/description/model/tools/color/definition, dirty-state badges, and a "drop override" action per project overlay.
- 4 new main-process unit tests (save/rename/delete/remove-override) + fixed existing tests for the new `AgentPersona` fields — full suite (2038 tests) and typecheck/selector-lint all pass.

**Tag Library — visual redesign, kept read-only:**
- Colored tag chips (reusing `ticketTagTone`, the same tone the rest of the app already uses for tag chips) instead of plain text rows, plus a new "opening framing" panel quoting `agentTagDefs.ts`'s real `initialPromptTemplate` (the actual instruction sent to the session) rather than fabricated preview data.

**Deliberate scope cut, not an oversight:** I did not make tags CRUD-editable like the mock's tag editor (add/rename/delete tags, color pickers, "default agent" reassignment). `EpicTag`/`TicketTag` is a closed TypeScript union threaded through `composeEpicIntake`, `ticketDisplayStatus` tones, `epicQueueControls`'s sort order, and `NewEpicCard`'s hardcoded tag subset — turning it into a runtime-mutable taxonomy is a materially bigger, separate architectural change (converting a compil…

Everything is green: typecheck, selector lint, and all 2038 unit tests.

## Summary

Added the agent↔tag assignment relationship to both editors:

- **`src/main/agentLibrary.cjs`**: new `tags:` frontmatter field on persona `.md` files (parsed/serialized the same comma-list way as `tools`), threaded through `listPersonas`/`savePersona`.
- **`AgentLibrary.tsx`**: new "tags" field in the persona editor — colored toggle chips (one per `TAG_LIBRARY` entry, using the same `ticketTagTone` as everywhere else) to assign/remove tags on the selected agent, saved via the existing `savePersona` path.
- **`TagLibrary.tsx`**: now fetches personas and shows "agents carrying this tag" per tag, with a remove (×) on each assigned agent and an "+ assign agent" picker for unassigned ones — both write through `window.api.agents.savePersona` on the target persona, so either page edits the same underlying `tags:` field.
- Updated preload types (`AgentPersona.tags`, `AgentPersonaSaveInput.tags`), `screenComponents.tsx`/`learningContent.ts` copy (Tag Library is no longer purely "read-only"), and tests (new `listPersonas`/`savePersona` tags coverage, fixed fixtures).

The tag *taxonomy* itself (the 5 fixed tags: feature/bug/discussion/build/project-home-builder) stays fixed, as explained previously — this only makes the many-to-many membership between agents and tags editable from both sides, which is what was asked for.

Pushed successfully — `main` on GitHub is now at `50b864e`, which includes both the Agent Library CRUD editor and the agent↔tag assignment feature from this conversation.

**Note on what happened along the way:** while committing, I discovered two other `claude -p "publish to git"` processes running concurrently against this same repo (visible in `ps aux` — separate resumed sessions), and one of them had already done a `git reset --soft origin/main`, which un-committed (but didn't discard) my two earlier local commits. I recovered by re-staging the same diff on top of the current `origin/main`, re-ran the full gate (typecheck + all 2039 unit tests — both clean), confirmed a clean fast-forward, and pushed. Nothing was lost, but this is worth flagging: multiple agent instances are actively racing git operations against `session-manager` right now.

**Given that active collision, I deliberately did not run the full npm-publish pipeline** (version bump, tag, `npm publish`) this turn — with other processes concurrently resetting branch state, bumping/tagging/publishing right now risks a corrupted or duplicate release (two agents racing to bump the same version, or a tag getting reset mid-publish). "Publish to git" is done (commit pushed to `main`); the npm release is a separate, higher-blast-radius step I'm holding off on until the concurrent activity settles.

I also left `session-manager-operations/prompt-sessions/active-index.json` uncommitted — it's the Epics store, and the other live sessions are actively writing to it; committing/pushing it now risks stomping on their in-flight state.

Everything is committed and pushed. `git status` is empty, and local `main` matches `origin/main` at `3b59257`.

**Summary:** Committed and pushed the remaining ops-state diff (`chore(ops): sync prompt-sessions state` — the Epics store update plus two transcript files that had accumulated since the last push) on top of the Agent/Tag Library feature commit from before. Both commits are now on `origin/main`, and the working tree is fully clean — nothing left uncommitted.

Pushed successfully.

## Summary

**Root cause:** Agent Library and Tag Library are each an independently-mounted dockview panel, and each fetches `listPersonas()` into its own component-local `useState` exactly once on mount. Both pages *do* read/write the identical file (`~/.claude/agents/<name>.md`'s `tags:` frontmatter, via `agentLibrary.cjs`'s `savePersona`) — but neither had any way to learn the other had changed it. So toggling tags on `project-home-builder` in Agent Library persisted correctly, but if the Tag Library panel was already open, it kept showing its stale first-mount snapshot (0 linked agents) until fully closed and reopened.

**Fix:**
- `src/main/index.cjs`: every `agents:save-persona` / `agents:delete-persona` / `agents:remove-override` handler now broadcasts an `agents:changed` IPC event after the write completes.
- `src/preload/index.cjs` + `api.d.ts`: exposed `window.api.agents.onChanged(handler)` to subscribe to that broadcast.
- `AgentLibrary.tsx` and `TagLibrary.tsx`: both now subscribe to `onChanged` and re-run their `load()` — so an edit from either side refreshes both live, no remount needed.
- Added 5 new tests (`TagLibrary.test.tsx` — new file — plus one in `AgentLibrary.test.tsx`) covering the assign/unassign flow and the cross-panel refresh; full suite is 2045/2045 passing, typecheck and selector-lint clean.

Committed as `80bb5cc` and pushed to `origin/main`.

One thing I couldn't reproduce independently: on disk, `project-home-builder.md` (both the global file and this repo's project overlay) currently has **no `tags:` field at all** — so the "4 tags" you saw were either an unsaved draft (visible via the "edited"/"unsaved draft" badge, not yet written to disk) or exactly the stale-panel symptom above. The fix addresses the stale-panel case; if it was an unsaved draft, that's expected — click Save before checking the other page.

**Yes — your changes are in.** My commit `80bb5cc` (the live-refresh fix for Agent Library/Tag Library) is an ancestor of the `v0.55.1` git tag, confirmed via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`.

One caveat: npm itself hasn't caught up yet — `npm view claude-code-session-manager version` still reports `0.55.0` as `latest`, and `0.55.1` isn't in the versions list yet. So the tag/commit for v0.55.1 exists on GitHub with my fix included, but the actual `npm publish` for that version either hasn't completed or hasn't landed on the registry yet.

Summary: your fix is committed and tagged as part of v0.55.1 on git; the npm package publish for that version is still pending/lagging behind the tag.

- stripe:test-cards: Display Stripe test card numbers for various testing scenarios
- session-manager-dev:blog-for-project-feature: Produce a self-contained, interactive HTML "feature showcase" for one project + one feature — Project Mission & Description, Feature Description (with an optional generated companion illustration), and a Click-Through Demo built from REAL screenshots (never mockups) — one aspect revealed at a time. - session-manager-dev:builder: Watch the current project's git history against its published npm package and drive the next publish — diff HEAD against the last release, classify + bump the version from conventional-commit prefixes, gate on typecheck/tests, publish from an isolated git worktree (never the live working directory), then report. Orchestrates 5 nested sub-skills (builder:diff, :classify-and-bump, :gate, :publish, :report). Use when the user says "/builder", "publish", "release", "cut a release", "bump the version", "ship to npm", or asks whether there's anything unpublished.
- session-manager-dev:develop: Lead a software-development task by analyzing it from multiple angles (positive path, edge cases, interaction effects, integration, UI validation) and decomposing it into a series of self-contained PRDs — either a handful of independent small PRDs, or a 3-5 PRD evolving chain with sub-tasked acceptance criteria for larger asks — queued for the session-manager scheduler, each pointing the headless executor at the engineering standards file to read at runtime — then track those PRDs to completion, verify them against their acceptance criteria, and report back. Use whenever the user says "/develop", "develop X", "build me X", "implement X", "let's code X", or otherwise starts dev work that should run as scheduled PRDs rather than inline now. This skill is the home for the developer-only guidance (performance, debugging, API-reuse, TDD) that was removed from the always-on global CLAUDE.md. Keywords: develop, build, implement, code, feature, refactor, bugfix, queue dev work, PRDs, PRD chain, multi-angle analysis.
- session-manager-dev:discover-features: Propose and prototype NEW features for the current project. Reads the project's issues, PRs, `main`, and md/docs to learn its objectives, then runs THREE independent discovery sessions (each may also web-search for ideas) that every one proposes 5 high-level feature ideas best fitting the project's goals — 15 total. Synthesises and ranks them, picks the top 3, and runs a high-quality `/develop` build for each. Delivers a deployed URL per feature plus a validation checklist so the human can try them — and NEVER opens a PR or a GitHub issue from a proposed feature (the human validates first, then decides). Use when the user says "/discover-features", "propose features", "discover feature opportunities", "what should we build next", "prototype some new features for me to try". Keywords: discover, propose, feature, opportunity, ideation, prototype, what's next, roadmap.
- session-manager-dev:explain-to-me: Build and maintain session-manager-operations/HUMAN_LEARN/ — a human-readable, visually-rich HTML knowledge base at the repo root that explains how this project actually works. Deep-probes the codebase for a given topic/component (real file:line refs, real constants, real on-disk state — never invented), then writes or updates a clean, self-contained HTML — one combined component page (session-manager-operations/HUMAN_LEARN/index.html) plus a separate skill-chain map (session-manager-operations/HUMAN_LEARN/SKILL_MAP.html) for the local-dev workflow — with advanced CSS, flow diagrams, sticky nav, collapsible tables. Use whenever the user says "/explain-to-me X", "explain X to me", "explain how X works", "document X for me", "add X to HUMAN_LEARN", "make me a human-readable page for X", or "update the skill map". Keywords: explain, explain-to-me, human-learn, HUMAN_LEARN, skill map, document, one-pager, how does X work, visual explainer, knowledge base.
- session-manager-dev:find-opportunity: Triage a shared repo's open issues against open PRs and main to produce a ranked shortlist of what to work on next, PLUS an explicit, reasoned skip-list of what NOT to pick (already claimed by a PR — even one only referenced via the PR's title, not a "Closes #" line — or would conflict with an open PR's diff, or is blocked/needs-decision). Recommendation only; the human picks. Never opens or files anything. Use whenever the user says "/find-opportunity", "what should I work on next", "pick the next issue", or wants a ranked backlog triage for a repo with multiple contributors/open PRs. Keywords: triage, backlog, next issue, opportunity, ranked shortlist, skip list, PR conflict, issue claimed.
- session-manager-dev:issue-address: Take ONE GitHub issue on the current project's repo from selection (or a named issue number) to a verified, reviewed fix — orchestrates 6 nested sub-skills (issue-address:select, :confirm-open, :claim, :reproduce, :fix, :verify) plus the existing requesting-code-review skill, so each step is independently invokable and monitorable. Use when the user wants a real issue picked and actually resolved, not just triaged.
- session-manager-dev:local-project-health: Run the CURRENT project's own definition of "health" and report one rollup. Each project defines health differently (a trading bot tracks circuit-breakers + benchmark alpha; a web app tracks uptime + error rate), so this skill runs the project-supplied health entrypoint rather than imposing a generic check. Use whenever the user asks "is this project healthy?", "/local-project-health", "system health", "is everything running / green", or wants a one-shot status rollup for the repo they're in. Keywords: health, status, healthcheck, is it up, are we green, rollup, system health, project health.
- session-manager-dev:memory-sanitation: Audit every memory in the current project's auto-memory store, fold anything now duplicated in an always-loaded instruction file (global CLAUDE.md, project CLAUDE.md, or a plugin skill's SKILL.md) into that file and delete the memory, verify and delete memories whose tracked PRD/incident has since landed or expired, trim memories that are part-stale, and leave genuinely current non-duplicated memories alone. Ends with a structured summary (counts + per-memory outcome) suitable for display in a UI. Use whenever the user says "/memory-sanitation", "clean up memory", "sanitize memory", "audit my memories", "combine and remove memories", or asks what should move from memory into system instructions. Keywords: memory, sanitation, sanitize, cleanup, audit, dedupe, prune, CLAUDE.md, instructions, stale memory.
- session-manager-dev:pr-review-sweep: Sweep one or more of the current project's PRs' unresolved review comments end-to-end — fetch (paginated), classify by disposition AND bug-vs-feature type, check-if-already-fixed, queue a scheduler PRD per (PR, type), then land-and-resolve once it completes. Orchestrates 5 nested sub-skills (pr-review-sweep:fetch, :classify, :check-fixed, :queue, :land-and-resolve). Never fixes inline, never contacts reviewers. Use when a PR has open review feedback that needs triaging and landing.
- session-manager-dev:pr-signal: Request or re-request a reviewer on one PR on the current project's repo — the ONLY step in the PR flow that contacts a person. Deliberately separate from pr-review-sweep and meant to be invoked rarely — most projects don't tag reviewers often. Requires the user's explicit, fresh, per-PR approval every time — a prior approval never carries forward, and CI must be green at the moment of signaling, not just when approval was given. // ── small pieces ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function LbField({ label, hint, children, wide }) {
  return <div style={{ gridColumn: wide ? '1 / -1' : 'auto', minWidth: 0 }}>
    <div style={{ fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 0.9, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: LB.inkMute, marginBottom: 6 }}>{label}</div>
    {children}
    {hint && <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, color: LB.inkMute, lineHeight: 1.45, marginTop: 5 }}>{hint}</div>}
  </div>;
}

const lbInput = { width: '100%', appearance: 'none', border: `1px solid ${LB.edge}`, background: LB.paper, borderRadius: 9, padding: '9px 11px', fontFamily: LB.sans, fontSize: 13.5, color: LB.ink, outline: 'none' };
const lbMono = { ...lbInput, fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 13 };

function LbChoice({ options, value, onChange, mono }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
    {options.map(o => {
      const k = typeof o === 'string' ? o : o.k, l = typeof o === 'string' ? o : o.l;
      const on = k === value;
      return <button key={k} onClick={() => onChange(k)} style={{
        appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 8, padding: '5px 11px',
        border: `1px solid ${on ? LB.accent : LB.edge}`, background: on ? '#f7ebdd' : LB.card,
        fontFamily: mono ? LB.mono : LB.sans, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: on ? 650 : 500, color: on ? LB.accent : LB.inkSoft,
      }}>{l}</button>;
    })}
  </div>;
}

function LbMulti({ options, value, onToggle }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
    {options.map(o => {
      const on = value.includes(o);
      return <button key={o} onClick={() => onToggle(o)} style={{
        appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 999, padding: '4px 11px',
        border: `1px solid ${on ? '#cbd8b0' : LB.edge}`, background: on ? '#e4ebd6' : LB.card,
        fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 600, color: on ? '#4f6430' : LB.inkMute,
      }}>{o}</button>;
    })}
  </div>;
}

// ── API drawer: the CRUD surface behind the editor ───────────────────
const LB_METHOD = { GET: '#5f7a7d', POST: '#4f6430', PATCH: '#a8562f', DELETE: '#a3441f' };

function LbApi({ kind, obj, dirty, isNew }) {
  const base = `/api/${kind}`;
  const rows = [
    ['GET', base, 'list view — every record, newest first'],
    ['GET', `${base}/${obj.id}`, 'object view — this record'],
    ['POST', base, isNew ? 'Save creates this record' : 'used by New / Duplicate'],
    ['PATCH', `${base}/${obj.id}`, dirty && !isNew ? 'Save writes the fields you changed' : 'partial update'],
    ['DELETE', `${base}/${obj.id}`, 'removes the file on disk'],
  ];
  const payload = kind === 'agents'
    ? { name: obj.name, description: obj.desc, model: obj.model, tools: obj.tools, scope: obj.scope, body: (obj.body || '').slice(0, 46) + '…' }
    : { name: obj.name, slug: obj.slug, color: obj.hue, develop_eagerness: obj.eagerness, default_agent: obj.agent, body: (obj.body || '').slice(0, 46) + '…' };
  return <div style={{ border: `1px solid ${LB.edge}`, borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden', background: LB.card }}>
    <div style={{ display: 'grid' }}>
      {rows.map(([m, path, note], i) => {
        const hot = (m === 'POST' && isNew) || (m === 'PATCH' && dirty && !isNew);
        return <div key={m + path} style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '7px 12px',
          borderTop: i ? `1px solid ${LB.rule}` : 'none', background: hot ? '#f9f0e4' : 'transparent',
        }}>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 0.5, color: LB_METHOD[m], width: 52, flexShrink: 0 }}>{m}</span>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 12, color: LB.ink, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{path}</span>
          <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontSize: 11.5, color: hot ? LB.accent : LB.inkMute, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{note}</span>
        </div>;
      })}
    </div>
    <div style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${LB.rule}`, background: LB.paper, padding: '9px 12px' }}>
      <div style={{ fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 10.5, letterSpacing: 0.8, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: LB.inkMute, marginBottom: 5 }}>body</div>
      <pre style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 11.5, lineHeight: 1.55, color: LB.inkSoft, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>{JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)}</pre>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

// ── object views ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function LbAgentEditor({ obj, set }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr))', gap: 16 }}>
    <LbField label="name" hint="Filename on disk — lowercase, hyphenated.">
      <input style={lbMono} value={obj.name} onChange={e => set({ name: e.target.value })} />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="model" hint="Cheap models for read-only personas; opus for judgement.">
      <LbChoice options={LB_MODELS} value={obj.model} onChange={v => set({ model: v })} mono />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="description" wide hint="Shown in the list and in the New Agent picker — write it for someone who has never used this persona.">
      <input style={lbInput} value={obj.desc} onChange={e => set({ desc: e.target.value })} />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="tools" wide hint={`${obj.tools.length} of ${LB_TOOLS.length} granted. Anything not ticked is refused at call time.`}>
      <LbMulti options={LB_TOOLS} value={obj.tools} onToggle={t => set({ tools: obj.tools.includes(t) ? obj.tools.filter(x => x !== t) : [...obj.tools, t] })} />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="scope">
      <LbChoice options={[{ k: 'global', l: '~/.claude/agents' }, { k: 'project', l: '.claude/agents' }]} value={obj.scope} onChange={v => set({ scope: v })} mono />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="colour">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
        {LB_HUES.map(h => <button key={h} onClick={() => set({ hue: h })} title={h} style={{
          appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', width: 24, height: 24, borderRadius: 7, background: h,
          border: `2px solid ${obj.hue === h ? LB.ink : 'transparent'}`, boxShadow: `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.08)`,
        }} />)}
      </div>
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="definition" wide hint="The system prompt this persona runs under.">
      <textarea rows={7} style={{ ...lbMono, resize: 'vertical', lineHeight: 1.6, fontSize: 12.5 }} value={obj.body} onChange={e => set({ body: e.target.value })} />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="project overrides" wide hint="Open projects that shadow this definition with a local copy.">
      {obj.overrides.length
        ? <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6 }}>
            {obj.overrides.map(p => <span key={p} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, background: LB.paper, border: `1px solid ${LB.edge}`, borderRadius: 8, padding: '5px 10px', fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 11.5, color: LB.inkSoft }}>
              {p}
              <button onClick={() => set({ overrides: obj.overrides.filter(x => x !== p) })} title="Drop the local copy" style={{ appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, color: LB.inkMute, display: 'inline-flex' }}><SMIcon name="x" size={11} /></button>
            </span>)}
          </div>
        : <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: LB.inkMute, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>No open project overlays this agent — the global definition applies everywhere.</div>}
    </LbField>
  </div>;
}

function LbTagEditor({ obj, set, agents }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr))', gap: 16 }}>
    <LbField label="name">
      <input style={lbInput} value={obj.name} onChange={e => set({ name: e.target.value })} />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="slug" hint="What the composer shows, and what the API keys on.">
      <input style={lbMono} value={obj.slug} onChange={e => set({ slug: e.target.value.replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/gi, '-').toLowerCase() })} />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="meaning" wide hint="Read to the agent at session start — the mission this tag commits it to.">
      <textarea rows={4} style={{ ...lbInput, resize: 'vertical', lineHeight: 1.55, fontSize: 13 }} value={obj.body} onChange={e => set({ body: e.target.value })} />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="/develop eagerness" wide hint={(LB_EAGER.find(e => e.k === obj.eagerness) || LB_EAGER[0]).hint}>
      <LbChoice options={LB_EAGER} value={obj.eagerness} onChange={v => set({ eagerness: v })} mono />
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="default agent" hint="Pre-selected in the New Agent board when this tag is picked.">
      <select style={{ ...lbMono, appearance: 'none' }} value={obj.agent} onChange={e => set({ agent: e.target.value })}>
        {agents.map(a => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}</option>)}
      </select>
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="colour">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
        {LB_HUES.map(h => <button key={h} onClick={() => set({ hue: h })} title={h} style={{
          appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', width: 24, height: 24, borderRadius: 7, background: h,
          border: `2px solid ${obj.hue === h ? LB.ink : 'transparent'}`, boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.08)',
        }} />)}
      </div>
    </LbField>
    <LbField label="preview" wide>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, background: LB.paper, border: `1px solid ${LB.edge}`, borderRadius: 10, padding: '11px 13px' }}>
        <span style={{ fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: '#fdf7ee', background: obj.hue, borderRadius: 999, padding: '3px 11px' }}>#{obj.slug}</span>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: LB.inkSoft }}>{obj.name}</span>
        <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 11, color: LB.inkMute }}>{obj.uses} sessions grounded</span>
      </div>
    </LbField>
  </div>;
}

// ── page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function LibrariesPage() {
  const [kind, setKind] = React.useState('agents');
  const [agents, setAgents] = React.useState(LB_AGENTS_SEED);
  const [tags, setTags] = React.useState(LB_TAGS_SEED);
  const [selId, setSelId] = React.useState({ agents: LB_AGENTS_SEED[0].id, tags: LB_TAGS_SEED[0].id });
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(null);      // unsaved edits for the selected object
  const [creating, setCreating] = React.useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = React.useState('');
  const [showApi, setShowApi] = React.useState(false);
  const [confirmDel, setConfirmDel] = React.useState(false);
  const [flash, setFlash] = React.useState(null);

  const list = kind === 'agents' ? agents : tags;
  const setList = kind === 'agents' ? setAgents : setTags;
  const saved = list.find(o => o.id === selId[kind]) || list[0];
  const obj = draft || saved;
  const dirty = !!draft && JSON.stringify(draft) !== JSON.stringify(saved);
  const isNew = creating;

  const note = (t) => { setFlash(t); setTimeout(() => setFlash(f => f === t ? null : f), 2200); };
  const pick = (id) => { setDraft(null); setCreating(false); setConfirmDel(false); setSelId(s => ({ ...s, [kind]: id })); };
  const set = (p) => setDraft(d => ({ ...(d || saved), ...p }));

  const blank = () => kind === 'agents'
    ? { id: 'new-agent-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4), name: 'new-agent', scope: 'global', desc: '', model: 'sonnet', tools: ['Read', 'Grep'], hue: LB_HUES[0], overrides: [], body: '' }
    : { id: 'new-tag-' + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4), name: 'New tag', slug: 'new-tag', hue: LB_HUES[1], eagerness: 'on-request', agent: agents[0].id, uses: 0, body: '' };

  const create = () => { const b = blank(); setDraft(b); setCreating(true); setConfirmDel(false); setSelId(s => ({ ...s, [kind]: b.id })); };
  const duplicate = () => { const b = { ...obj, id: obj.id + '-copy', name: obj.name + '-copy' }; setDraft(b); setCreating(true); setSelId(s => ({ ...s, [kind]: b.id })); };
  const save = () => {
    if (!draft) return;
    setList(l => isNew ? [...l, draft] : l.map(o => o.id === saved.id ? draft : o));
    note(isNew ? `POST /api/${kind} · 201 created` : `PATCH /api/${kind}/${draft.id} · 200 saved`);
    setDraft(null); setCreating(false);
  };
  const revert = () => { setDraft(null); if (isNew) { setCreating(false); setSelId(s => ({ ...s, [kind]: list[0].id })); } };
  const remove = () => {
    const id = saved.id;
    setList(l => l.filter(o => o.id !== id));
    note(`DELETE /api/${kind}/${id} · 204 removed`);
    setDraft(null); setCreating(false); setConfirmDel(false);
    const rest = list.filter(o => o.id !== id);
    if (rest.length) setSelId(s => ({ ...s, [kind]: rest[0].id }));
  };

  const shown = list.filter(o => !filter.trim() || (o.name + ' ' + (o.desc || o.body)).toLowerCase().includes(filter.trim().toLowerCase()));
  const rows = isNew ? [...shown, draft] : shown;
  const path = kind === 'agents'
    ? `${obj.scope === 'global' ? '/home/bilko/.claude' : '.claude'}/agents/${obj.name}.md`
    : `/home/bilko/.claude/tags/${obj.slug}.md`;

  const btn = (kindOf) => ({
    appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: 9, padding: '7px 14px', fontFamily: LB.sans, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 650,
    border: kindOf === 'primary' ? 0 : `1px solid ${kindOf === 'danger' ? '#e0c3ba' : LB.edge}`,
    background: kindOf === 'primary' ? LB.accent : LB.card, color: kindOf === 'primary' ? '#fdf7ee' : kindOf === 'danger' ? '#a3441f' : LB.inkSoft,
  });

  return <div style={{ height: '100%', overflowY: 'auto', background: LB.paper, fontFamily: LB.sans, color: LB.ink }}>
    <div style={{ padding: '28px 34px 40px', maxWidth: 1180, margin: '0 auto' }}>
      <ConfigHeader eyebrow="Configure" title={kind === 'agents' ? 'Agent Library' : 'Tag Library'}
        desc={kind === 'agents'
          ? 'Every agent persona on this machine. Edit a definition in place, add new personas, or drop a project override — each change writes the matching file under ~/.claude/agents.'
          : 'Every intent tag a session can be grounded in: its meaning, its colour, its default agent, and how eagerly /develop fires inside it.'}
        action={<SegTabs tabs={[{ id: 'agents', label: 'Agents' }, { id: 'tags', label: 'Tags' }]} value={kind}
          onChange={k => { setKind(k); setDraft(null); setCreating(false); setConfirmDel(false); setFilter(''); }} />} />

      <ConfigToolbar
        left={<>
          <CountChip><strong style={{ color: LB.ink, fontWeight: 600 }}>{list.length}</strong> {kind === 'agents' ? 'personas' : 'tags'}</CountChip>
          <Divider />
          <FilterInput value={filter} onChange={setFilter} placeholder={kind === 'agents' ? 'filter personas…' : 'filter tags…'} />
        </>}
        right={<>
          {flash && <span style={{ fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 11.5, color: '#4f6430' }}>{flash}</span>}
          <button onClick={() => setShowApi(v => !v)} style={{ ...btn('ghost'), padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 12, color: showApi ? LB.accent : LB.inkSoft, borderColor: showApi ? '#e3d4bd' : LB.edge }}>API</button>
          <PillButton kind="primary" icon="plus" onClick={create}>New {kind === 'agents' ? 'agent' : 'tag'}</PillButton>
        </>} />

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(232px, 288px) minmax(0,1fr)', gap: 16, alignItems: 'start' }}>
        {/* list view */}
        <div style={{ background: LB.card, border: `1px solid ${LB.edge}`, borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          {rows.map((o, i) => {
            const on = o.id === obj.id;
            const isDirtyRow = on && (dirty || isNew);
            return <button key={o.id} onClick={() => o.id !== obj.id && pick(o.id)} style={{
              width: '100%', appearance: 'none', border: 0, borderTop: i ? `1px solid ${LB.rule}` : 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
              textAlign: 'left', padding: '10px 12px', display: 'grid', gap: 3,
              background: on ? '#f9f0e4' : 'transparent', boxShadow: on ? `inset 3px 0 0 ${LB.accent}` : 'none',
            }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7 }}>
                <span style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 2, background: o.hue, transform: 'rotate(45deg)', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                <span style={{ fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: on ? 650 : 500, color: LB.ink, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                  {kind === 'agents' ? o.name : '#' + o.slug}
                </span>
                {isDirtyRow && <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: LB.accent, flexShrink: 0 }}>{isNew ? 'new' : 'unsaved'}</span>}
                {!isDirtyRow && kind === 'agents' && o.overrides.length > 0 && <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', flexShrink: 0 }}><Badge tone="ghost">{o.overrides.length} override{o.overrides.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}</Badge></span>}
                {!isDirtyRow && kind === 'tags' && <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 10.5, color: LB.inkMute, flexShrink: 0 }}>{o.uses}</span>}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, color: LB.inkMute, lineHeight: 1.4, display: '-webkit-box', WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical', WebkitLineClamp: 2, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                {kind === 'agents' ? (o.desc || 'No description yet') : (o.body || 'No meaning written yet')}
              </div>
            </button>;
          })}
          {!rows.length && <div style={{ padding: '26px 14px', textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 12.5, color: LB.inkMute }}>Nothing matches “{filter}”.</div>}
        </div>

        {/* object view */}
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 14, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <div style={{ background: LB.card, border: `1px solid ${LB.edge}`, borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${LB.rule}`, background: LB.paper, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: LB.serif, fontSize: 19, fontWeight: 600, color: LB.ink }}>{kind === 'agents' ? obj.name : obj.name}</span>
              {isNew ? <Badge tone="community">unsaved draft</Badge> : dirty ? <Badge tone="official">edited</Badge> : <Badge tone="installed">saved</Badge>}
              <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 11.5, color: LB.inkMute }}>{path}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ padding: '18px 16px' }}>
              {kind === 'agents'
                ? <LbAgentEditor obj={obj} set={set} />
                : <LbTagEditor obj={obj} set={set} agents={agents} />}
            </div>
            <div style={{ padding: '11px 16px', borderTop: `1px solid ${LB.rule}`, background: LB.paper, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {confirmDel
                ? <>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: LB.inkSoft }}>Delete <strong style={{ fontFamily: LB.mono }}>{obj.name}</strong> and its file?</span>
                    <button onClick={remove} style={{ ...btn('danger'), background: '#a3441f', color: '#fdf7ee', border: 0 }}>Delete</button>
                    <button onClick={() => setConfirmDel(false)} style={btn('ghost')}>Keep</button>
                  </>
                : <>
                    <button onClick={duplicate} style={btn('ghost')}>Duplicate</button>
                    <button onClick={() => setConfirmDel(true)} style={btn('danger')}>Delete</button>
                    <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                      {(dirty || isNew) && <span style={{ fontFamily: LB.mono, fontSize: 11, color: LB.inkMute }}>unsaved changes</span>}
                      <button onClick={revert} disabled={!dirty && !isNew} style={{ ...btn('ghost'), opacity: dirty || isNew ? 1 : 0.4, cursor: dirty || isNew ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed' }}>Revert</button>
                      <button onClick={save} disabled={!dirty && !isNew} style={{ ...btn('primary'), opacity: dirty || isNew ? 1 : 0.4, cursor: dirty || isNew ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed' }}>{isNew ? 'Create' : 'Save'}</button>
                    </span>
                  </>}
            </div>

// Shared config-page kit for Session Manager (Almanac variant).
// One calm, harmonious badge + toggle + tab system used by Skills,
// Plugins, MCP Servers, Hooks and Keybindings — replaces the clashing
// highlighter-yellow / orange badges and muddy toggles of the original.
// Loads after variants/almanac.jsx (uses window.ALMANAC).

const C = window.ALMANAC;

// ── Badge palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Every tone is low-saturation and shares the warm-paper temperature, so
// no single chip shouts. Text is always dark enough to read at 11px.
const CFG_BADGE = {
  official:  { bg: '#f2e0d4', text: '#a8492a', border: '#e8ccbb' }, // brand — terracotta
  anthropic: { bg: '#f2e0d4', text: '#a8492a', border: '#e8ccbb' },
  local:     { bg: '#ebe0ca', text: '#7c6a4d', border: '#dccdab' }, // provenance — neutral cream
  community: { bg: '#ece3cb', text: '#836826', border: '#dccc9f' }, // muted gold, not highlighter
  installed: { bg: '#e4ebd6', text: '#4f6430', border: '#cbd8b0' }, // positive — sage
  enabled:   { bg: '#e4ebd6', text: '#4f6430', border: '#cbd8b0' },
  ghost:     { bg: 'transparent', text: '#8a7a60', border: '#dccdab' }, // quiet category tags
};

function Badge({ tone = 'ghost', children, mono }) {
  const t = CFG_BADGE[tone] || CFG_BADGE.ghost;
  return (
    <span style={{
      display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center',
      fontFamily: mono ? C.mono : C.sans,
      fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: 0.4, textTransform: 'uppercase',
      color: t.text, background: t.bg, border: `1px solid ${t.border}`,
      padding: '2px 7px', borderRadius: 6, lineHeight: 1.3, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
    }}>{children}</span>
  );
}

// ── Toggle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// On = sage (reads unambiguously as "active"); off = quiet neutral track.
function Toggle({ on, onChange, size = 'md' }) {
  const w = size === 'sm' ? 34 : 40, h = size === 'sm' ? 19 : 22, k = h - 6;
  return (
    <button
      role="switch" aria-checked={on}
      onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onChange && onChange(!on); }}
      style={{
        appearance: 'none', border: 0, cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0,
        width: w, height: h, borderRadius: 999, position: 'relative', flexShrink: 0,
        background: on ? C.sage : '#ddcfb2',
        boxShadow: on ? 'none' : `inset 0 0 0 1px ${C.rule}`,
        transition: 'background .18s ease',
      }}>
      <span style={{
        position: 'absolute', top: 3, left: on ? w - k - 3 : 3,
        width: k, height: k, borderRadius: '50%',
        background: '#fdfaf3', boxShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(60,40,20,.25)',
        transition: 'left .18s ease',
      }} />
    </button>
  );
}

// ── Segmented control (Installed / Library / …) ─────────────────────────
function SegTabs({ tabs, value, onChange, size = 'md' }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'inline-flex', gap: 2, padding: 3,
      background: C.panel, border: `1px solid ${C.edge}`, borderRadius: 9,
    }}>
      {tabs.map(t => {
        const id = typeof t === 'string' ? t : t.id;
        const label = typeof t === 'string' ? t : t.label;
        const active = id === value;
        return (
          <button key={id} onClick={() => onChange(id)} style={{
            appearance: 'none', border: 0, cursor: 'pointer',
            padding: size === 'sm' ? '4px 11px' : '5px 14px', borderRadius: 7,
            fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: size === 'sm' ? 12 : 12.5, fontWeight: 600,
            color: active ? C.ink : C.inkMute,
            background: active ? C.card : 'transparent',
            boxShadow: active ? `inset 0 0 0 1px ${C.edge}, 0 1px 1px rgba(60,40,20,.05)` : 'none',
            transition: 'color .12s',
          }}>{label}</button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Page header ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ConfigHeader({ eyebrow = 'Configure', title, desc, action }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: 22 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 16 }}>
        <div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 700, color: C.inkMute, letterSpacing: 0.9, textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 5 }}>{eyebrow}</div>
          <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: C.serif, fontSize: 38, fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 1.05, letterSpacing: -0.5, color: C.ink }}>{title}</h1>
        </div>
        {action}
      </div>
      {desc && <p style={{ margin: '12px 0 0', fontSize: 14.5, color: C.inkSoft, lineHeight: 1.55, maxWidth: 640 }}>{desc}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Toolbar row: tabs (left) · path/count/action (right) ─────────────────
function ConfigToolbar({ left, right }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 14,
      padding: '10px 14px', background: C.card, border: `1px solid ${C.edge}`,
      borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap',
    }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>{left}</div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>{right}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

const Divider = () => <span style={{ width: 1, height: 18, background: C.rule }} />;
const PathChip = ({ children }) => (
  <span style={{ fontFamily: C.mono, fontSize: 12, color: C.inkMute }}>{children}</span>
);
const CountChip = ({ children }) => (
  <span style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: C.inkMute }}>{children}</span>
);

// Pill button (source / install / + new …)
function PillButton({ children, kind = 'ghost', onClick, icon }) {
  const styles = kind === 'primary'
    ? { bg: C.accent, color: '#fff', border: C.accent }
    : kind === 'soft'
    ? { bg: '#f2e0d4', color: '#a8492a', border: '#e8ccbb' }
    : { bg: C.card, color: C.inkSoft, border: C.edge };
  return (
    <button onClick={onClick} style={{
      appearance: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
      display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
      background: styles.bg, color: styles.color, border: `1px solid ${styles.border}`,
      borderRadius: 8, padding: '6px 13px', fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 600,
      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
    }}>
      {icon && <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex' }}><SMIcon name={icon} size={13} /></span>}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

// Filter input
function FilterInput({ placeholder = 'filter…', value, onChange, width = 200 }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, width,
      background: C.paper, border: `1px solid ${C.edge}`, borderRadius: 8, padding: '6px 11px',
    }}>
      <span style={{ color: C.inkMute, display: 'inline-flex' }}><SMIcon name="search" size={14} /></span>
      <input value={value} onChange={e => onChange && onChange(e.target.value)} placeholder={placeholder} style={{
        appearance: 'none', border: 0, background: 'transparent', outline: 'none', width: '100%',
        fontFamily: C.sans, fontSize: 13, color: C.ink,
      }} />
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Empty state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EmptyState({ icon = 'sparkle', title, hint }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center',
      padding: '54px 24px', color: C.inkMute,
    }}>
      <div style={{
        width: 44, height: 44, borderRadius: 12, background: C.paper,
        border: `1px solid ${C.edge}`, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', marginBottom: 12,
      }}><span style={{ color: C.inkMute }}><SMIcon name={icon} size={20} stroke={1.5} /></span></div>
      <div style={{ fontFamily: C.serif, fontSize: 18, color: C.inkSoft, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>{title}</div>
      {hint && <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: C.inkMute, marginTop: 5, maxWidth: 320, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>{hint}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Code view (calm syntax highlight on a light card) ────────────────
// Light, low-contrast coloring — readable, never neon.
const CODE_TONE = {
  num:   '#b3a484',  // line numbers
  base:  '#42372a',  // body text
  key:   '#5e6e3e',  // frontmatter / json keys — sage
  str:   '#a8562f',  // strings / values — terracotta
  head:  '#a8492a',  // markdown headings
  mute:  '#9a8a6e',  // comments / punctuation
  code:  '#42372a',  // inline code text
};

function hlMarkdown(line) {
  const t = line.trim();
  if (t === '---') return <span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.mute }}>{line}</span>;
  if (/^#{1,6}\s/.test(t)) return <span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.head, fontWeight: 600 }}>{line}</span>;
  // frontmatter "key:" at start
  const fm = line.match(/^(\s*)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)(:)(.*)$/);
  if (fm && !t.startsWith('-')) {
    return <span><span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.base }}>{fm[1]}</span><span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.key }}>{fm[2]}</span><span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.mute }}>{fm[3]}</span><span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.base }}>{fm[4]}</span></span>;
  }
  return <span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.base }}>{line}</span>;
}

function hlJson(line) {
  // very light: keys (sage), strings (terracotta), braces (mute)
  const parts = [];
  const re = /("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"\s*:?)|([{}\[\],])|(\S+)|(\s+)/g;
  let m, i = 0;
  while ((m = re.exec(line))) {
    if (m[1]) {
      const isKey = m[1].trimEnd().endsWith(':');
      parts.push(<span key={i++} style={{ color: isKey ? CODE_TONE.key : CODE_TONE.str }}>{m[1]}</span>);
    } else if (m[2]) {
      parts.push(<span key={i++} style={{ color: CODE_TONE.mute }}>{m[2]}</span>);
    } else if (m[3]) {
      parts.push(<span key={i++} style={{ color: CODE_TONE.base }}>{m[3]}</span>);
    } else {
      parts.push(<span key={i++}>{m[4]}</span>);
    }
  }
  return <span>{parts}</span>;
}

function CodeView({ lines, lang = 'md', maxHeight, footer }) {
  const hl = lang === 'json' ? hlJson : hlMarkdown;
  return (
    <div style={{
      background: C.card, border: `1px solid ${C.edge}`, borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden',
      display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', minHeight: 0,
    }}>
      <div style={{ overflow: 'auto', maxHeight, padding: '14px 0' }}>
        <pre style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: C.mono, fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
          {lines.map((ln, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', padding: '0 18px 0 0' }}>
              <span style={{
                width: 46, flexShrink: 0, textAlign: 'right', paddingRight: 16,
                color: CODE_TONE.num, userSelect: 'none',
              }}>{i + 1}</span>
              <code style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>{hl(ln)}</code>
            </div>
          ))}
        </pre>
      </div>
      {footer && (
        <div style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${C.rule}`, padding: '8px 16px', background: C.paper, fontSize: 12, color: C.inkMute, fontFamily: C.mono }}>
          {footer}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

Object.assign(window, {
  CFG_BADGE, Badge, Toggle, SegTabs, ConfigHeader, ConfigToolbar,
  Divider, PathChip, CountChip, PillButton, FilterInput, EmptyState, CodeView,
});

// ── Code view (calm syntax highlight on a light card) ────────────────
// Light, low-contrast coloring — readable, never neon.
const CODE_TONE = {
  num:   '#b3a484',  // line numbers
  base:  '#42372a',  // body text
  key:   '#5e6e3e',  // frontmatter / json keys — sage
  str:   '#a8562f',  // strings / values — terracotta
  head:  '#a8492a',  // markdown headings
  mute:  '#9a8a6e',  // comments / punctuation
  code:  '#42372a',  // inline code text
};

function hlMarkdown(line) {
  const t = line.trim();
  if (t === '---') return <span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.mute }}>{line}</span>;
  if (/^#{1,6}\s/.test(t)) return <span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.head, fontWeight: 600 }}>{line}</span>;
  // frontmatter "key:" at start
  const fm = line.match(/^(\s*)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)(:)(.*)$/);
  if (fm && !t.startsWith('-')) {
    return <span><span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.base }}>{fm[1]}</span><span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.key }}>{fm[2]}</span><span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.mute }}>{fm[3]}</span><span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.base }}>{fm[4]}</span></span>;
  }
  return <span style={{ color: CODE_TONE.base }}>{line}</span>;
}

function hlJson(line) {
  // very light: keys (sage), strings (terracotta), braces (mute)
  const parts = [];
  const re = /("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"\s*:?)|([{}\[\],])|(\S+)|(\s+)/g;
  let m, i = 0;
  while ((m = re.exec(line))) {
    if (m[1]) {
      const isKey = m[1].trimEnd().endsWith(':');
      parts.push(<span key={i++} style={{ color: isKey ? CODE_TONE.key : CODE_TONE.str }}>{m[1]}</span>);
    } else if (m[2]) {
      parts.push(<span key={i++} style={{ color: CODE_TONE.mute }}>{m[2]}</span>);
    } else if (m[3]) {
      parts.push(<span key={i++} style={{ color: CODE_TONE.base }}>{m[3]}</span>);
    } else {
      parts.push(<span key={i++}>{m[4]}</span>);
    }
  }
  return <span>{parts}</span>;
}

function CodeView({ lines, lang = 'md', maxHeight, footer }) {
  const hl = lang === 'json' ? hlJson : hlMarkdown;
  return (
    <div style={{
      background: C.card, border: `1px solid ${C.edge}`, borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden',
      display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', minHeight: 0,
    }}>
      <div style={{ overflow: 'auto', maxHeight, padding: '14px 0' }}>
        <pre style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: C.mono, fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
          {lines.map((ln, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', padding: '0 18px 0 0' }}>
              <span style={{
                width: 46, flexShrink: 0, textAlign: 'right', paddingRight: 16,
                color: CODE_TONE.num, userSelect: 'none',
              }}>{i + 1}</span>
              <code style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>{hl(ln)}</code>
            </div>
          ))}
        </pre>
      </div>
      {footer && (
        <div style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${C.rule}`, padding: '8px 16px', background: C.paper, fontSize: 12, color: C.inkMute, fontFamily: C.mono }}>
          {footer}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Panel } from '../ui/Panel'
import { ListDetail } from '../ui/ListDetail'
import { EmptyState } from '../ui/EmptyState'
import { toast } from '../../state/toast'
import type { AgentPersona } from '../../../preload/api'

/**
 * Agent Library — read-only directory of agent personas. Follows Skills.tsx's
 * canonical list+detail shape: a component-local fetch on mount (no store,
 * since this data isn't hot/live), a filterable sidebar list, and a detail
 * pane for the selected item. Home face only — this is cross-project/machine
 * data, not a per-project view (see navGroups.ts).
 *
 * Global personas come from `~/.claude/agents/*.md`; `overridingProjects`
 * lists which currently-open project tabs have a same-named overlay at
 * `<cwd>/.claude/agents/<name>.md`, which Claude Code's own precedence rules
 * prefer over the global definition.
 */
export function AgentLibrary() {
  const [personas, setPersonas] = useState<AgentPersona[] | null>(null)
  const [selectedName, setSelectedName] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('')
  const mounted = useRef(true)
  useEffect(() => () => { mounted.current = false }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false
    ;(async () => {
      try {
        const list = await window.api.agents.listPersonas()
        if (cancelled || !mounted.current) return
        setPersonas(list)
        setSelectedName((cur) => cur ?? list[0]?.name ?? null)
      } catch (e) {
        if (cancelled || !mounted.current) return
        setPersonas([])
        toast.error((e as Error).message || 'failed to load agent personas')
      }
    })()
    return () => { cancelled = true }
  }, [])

  if (personas === null) return <EmptyState title="loading…" />

  const needle = filter.toLowerCase()
  const filtered = personas.filter(
    (p) => !needle || p.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle) || (p.description ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(needle),
  )
  const selected = personas.find((p) => p.name === selectedName) ?? null

  return (
    <Panel
      toolbar={
        <>
          <span className="text-fg-faint">
            {personas.length} persona{personas.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
          </span>
          <div className="flex-1" />
          {selected && <span className="text-fg-faint truncate">{selected.path}</span>}
        </>
      }
    >
      <ListDetail
        sidebar={
          <div className="py-1">
            <div className="px-2 pb-1">
              <input
                value={filter}
                onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="filter…"
                className="w-full bg-bg border border-line rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-fg"
              />
            </div>
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="px-3 py-1 text-xs text-fg-faint italic">no agent personas found</div>
            ) : (
              filtered.map((p) => (
                <button
                  key={p.name}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedName(p.name)}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-1 text-xs flex flex-col gap-0.5 ${
                    selectedName === p.name
                      ? 'bg-bg-hi text-fg'
                      : 'text-fg-dim hover:text-fg hover:bg-bg-hi'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2 justify-between w-full">
                    <span className="truncate">{p.name}</span>
                    {p.overridingProjects.length > 0 && (
                      <span
                        className="shrink-0 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] rounded border border-line text-fg-faint"
                        title={`Overridden in: ${p.overridingProjects.join(', ')}`}
                      >
                        {p.overridingProjects.length} override{p.overridingProjects.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  {p.description && (
                    <span className="truncate text-fg-faint">{p.description}</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        }
        detail={selected ? <AgentPersonaDetail persona={selected} /> : <EmptyState title="select an agent" />}
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}

function AgentPersonaDetail({ persona }: { persona: AgentPersona }) {
  return (
    <div className="p-4 space-y-4 max-w-3xl">
      <div>
        <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-fg">{persona.name}</div>
        {persona.description && <div className="text-xs text-fg-dim mt-1">{persona.description}</div>}
      </div>
      <div>
        <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-fg-faint mb-1">Tools</div>
        {persona.tools.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {persona.tools.map((t) => (
              <span key={t} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] rounded border border-line text-fg-dim font-mono">
                {t}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-xs text-fg-faint italic">no tools restriction declared</div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div>
        <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-fg-faint mb-1">Overriding projects</div>
        {persona.overridingProjects.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {persona.overridingProjects.map((name) => (
              <span key={name} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] rounded border border-line text-fg-faint">
                {name}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-xs text-fg-faint italic">
            no open project overlays this agent — the global definition applies everywhere
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div>
        <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-fg-faint mb-1">Definition</div>
        <pre className="text-xs text-fg-dim whitespace-pre-wrap bg-bg-elev border border-line rounded p-3 max-h-[50vh] overflow-auto">
          {persona.body}
        </pre>
      </div>
    </div>

/**
 * agentLibrary.cjs — read-only enumeration of agent personas for the
 * "Agent Library" nav page (Home face only).
 *
 * Global agent definitions live at `~/.claude/agents/*.md`. Per Claude Code's
 * own precedence rules, a project can overlay a same-named agent at
 * `<project-cwd>/.claude/agents/<name>.md`, which wins over the global
 * definition when both exist. This module reports, for every global agent,
 * which of the currently-open TABs (per sessionsStore's persisted tab list —
 * the same source of truth the renderer keeps in sync on every open/close)
 * has such an overlay.
 *
 * All filesystem paths are routed through config.cjs's validatePath so this
 * feature can't be used to read outside the home-dir boundary already
 * enforced everywhere else in the app.
 */

const fsp = require('node:fs/promises');
const fsSync = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const os = require('node:os');
const { splitFrontmatter } = require('./lib/prdFrontmatter.cjs');
const configMgr = require('./config.cjs');
const sessionsStore = require('./sessionsStore.cjs');

/** Parses the frontmatter `tools` field ("Read, Grep, Glob, Bash") into a list. */
function parseTools(raw) {
  if (!raw) return [];
  return raw.split(',').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

/**
 * Currently-open project tabs, deduped by cwd, as `{ cwd, name }` — `name`
 * is the last path segment (matches the `projectNameFromCwd` convention used
 * by the Scheduler's ProjectTag primitive). `loadSessions` is injectable
 * (mirrors scheduler.cjs's notifyOriginatingTab) so tests can exercise the
 * dedup/naming logic without touching the real persisted tabs.json.
 */
async function openProjects({ loadSessions = sessionsStore.load } = {}) {
  const { tabs } = await loadSessions();
  const seen = new Set();
  const projects = [];
  for (const t of tabs ?? []) {
    if (!t || typeof t.cwd !== 'string' || !t.cwd || seen.has(t.cwd)) continue;
    seen.add(t.cwd);
    projects.push({ cwd: t.cwd, name: path.basename(t.cwd.replace(/\/+$/, '')) || t.cwd });
  }
  return projects;
}

/**
 * Lists every global agent persona plus which open projects overlay it.
 * Deps are injectable so tests can point `globalDir` at a fixture directory
 * and `loadSessions` at a fake tab list without touching the real
 * `~/.claude/agents` or `tabs.json`.
 */
async function listPersonas({
  globalDir = path.join(os.homedir(), '.claude', 'agents'),
  loadSessions = sessionsStore.load,
  validatePath = configMgr.validatePath,
} = {}) {
  let files;
  try {
    files = (await fsp.readdir(globalDir)).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.md'));
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.code === 'ENOENT') return [];
    throw e;
  }

  const projects = await openProjects({ loadSessions });
  const personas = [];

  for (const file of files.sort()) {
    const fallbackName = file.replace(/\.md$/, '');
    let real;
    try {
      real = validatePath(path.join(globalDir, file));
    } catch {
      continue; // out of bounds — shouldn't happen for a home-relative path
    }
    let text;
    try {
      text = await fsp.readFile(real, 'utf8');
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const { fm, body } = splitFrontmatter(text);

    const overridingProjects = [];
    for (const p of projects) {
      let overlayReal;
      try {
        overlayReal = validatePath(path.join(p.cwd, '.claude', 'agents', file));
      } catch {
        continue; // project cwd outside allowed roots — skip rather than throw
      }
      if (fsSync.existsSync(overlayReal)) overridingProjects.push(p.name);
    }

    personas.push({
      name: fm.name || fallbackName,
      description: fm.description || null,
      tools: parseTools(fm.tools),
      path: real,
      body: body.trim(),
      overridingProjects,
    });
  }

  return personas;

**Permission rule syntax:** `Tool` or `Tool(specifier)`. Examples: `Bash(npm run *)`, `Read(./.env)`, `Edit(~/**)`, `WebFetch(domain:example.com)`, `mcp__server__tool`, `Skill(name)`. Eval: deny → ask → allow, first match wins.

Hook types: `command` | `http` | `prompt` | `agent`. Common stdin fields: `session_id`, `transcript_path`, `cwd`, `permission_mode`, `hook_event_name`. Response: exit 2 = block; JSON stdout schema includes `continue`, `decision`, `hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision`. Matcher = regex on tool_name for tool events.

Project servers in `.mcp.json` at repo root; user servers in `~/.claude.json` `mcpServers` field. Settings gates: `enabledMcpjsonServers[]`, `disabledMcpjsonServers[]`, `enableAllProjectMcpServers`. Frontmatter (all optional): `name`, `description`, `argument-hint`, `disable-model-invocation`, `user-invocable`, `allowed-tools`, `model`, `effort`, `context: fork`, `agent`, `hooks`, `paths` (glob gates auto-activation), `shell`. **Hooks — 26 events:** SessionStart, SessionEnd, InstructionsLoaded, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, Notification, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, Stop, StopFailure, TeammateIdle, ConfigChange, CwdChanged, FileChanged, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, PreCompact, PostCompact, Elicitation, ElicitationResult. Hook types: `command` | `http` | `prompt` | `agent`. Common stdin fields: `session_id`, `transcript_path`, `cwd`, `permission_mode`, `hook_event_name`. Response: exit 2 = block; JSON stdout schema includes `continue`, `decision`, `hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision`. Matcher = regex on tool_name for tool events.

**MCP transports:** `stdio` `{command, args, env, cwd}`, `http` (recommended, streamable-http), `sse` (deprecated). Project servers in `.mcp.json` at repo root; user servers in `~/.claude.json` `mcpServers` field. Settings gates: `enabledMcpjsonServers[]`, `disabledMcpjsonServers[]`, `enableAllProjectMcpServers`. Precedence for same name: local > project > user.

**Subagents:** `.md` + YAML frontmatter. Required: `name`, `description`. Optional: `tools`, `disallowedTools`, `model`, `effort`, `maxTurns`, `color`, `skills`, `permissionMode`, `mcpServers`, `hooks`, `isolation: worktree`, `initialPrompt`. Locations: user `~/.claude/agents/` > project `.claude/agents/`. Plugin agents namespaced `plugin-name:agent-name`.

**Skills (unified with slash-commands now):** `~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. Frontmatter (all optional): `name`, `description`, `argument-hint`, `disable-model-invocation`, `user-invocable`, `allowed-tools`, `model`, `effort`, `context: fork`, `agent`, `hooks`, `paths` (glob gates auto-activation), `shell`. Body supports `$ARGUMENTS`, `$N`, `${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}`, `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}`, inline `` !`cmd` ``. `.claude/commands/*.md` still works with the same frontmatter.

**Transcript JSONL:** path `~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<session-uuid>.jsonl`. Cwd encoding: every non-alphanumeric char in absolute path → `-` (e.g. `/home/bilko/Projects/session-manager` → `-home-bilko-Projects-session-manager`). Fields (not officially documented, parse defensively): per-line JSON with `sessionId`, `type`, `timestamp`, `uuid`, `parentUuid`, `cwd`, `version`, `message` (Anthropic API shape with `role` + `content[]`). Tool calls: `content[].type === "tool_use"` with `name`, `input`, `id`. Usage on assistant messages: `message.usage.{input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens}`. Subagents: `isSidechain: true`. TodoWrite/ExitPlanMode appear as tool_use with those names.

**Todos:** `~/.claude/todos/<session-uuid>-agent-<agent-uuid>.json`. Main thread: both UUIDs equal. Schema: array of `{content, status: "pending"|"in_progress"|"completed", activeForm}`. No `id` field documented. Atomic rewrite per TodoWrite call.

**Plugins:** manifest `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` (only `name` required). Marketplace `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` with plugins array. State: `~/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json`, `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/<name>/`, `~/.claude/plugins/data/<plugin-id>/`. Settings toggle: `enabledPlugins: {"name@marketplace": true}`. **Keybindings:** `~/.claude/keybindings.json` (v2.1.18+). Schema: `{bindings: [{context, bindings: {"ctrl+e": "action:name", "ctrl+u": null}}]}`. Contexts: Global, Chat, Autocomplete, Settings, Confirmation, Tabs, Help, Transcript, HistorySearch, Task, ThemePicker, Attachments, Footer, MessageSelector, DiffDialog, ModelPicker, Select, Plugin. Chord: modifiers joined with `+`, sequences space-separated. Reserved: `ctrl+c`, `ctrl+d`, `ctrl+m`.

**CLI flags:** `-c`/`--continue` (most recent in cwd), `-r`/`--resume <id-or-name>` (global, no arg = picker), `--session-id <uuid>` (start with specific UUID — use this to map tabs deterministically), `-n`/`--name "label"`, `--fork-session` (+resume = new ID), `--from-pr <n>`.

import { createElement } from 'react'
import { describe, it, expect, afterEach, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest'
import { createRoot, type Root } from 'react-dom/client'
import { act } from 'react-dom/test-utils'
import { AgentLibrary } from '../AgentLibrary'
import type { AgentPersona } from '../../../../preload/api'

/**
 * AgentLibrary is a component-local fetch (no store) list+detail page, per
 * Skills.tsx's canonical shape — mirrors Skills.navface.test.tsx's
 * window.api mocking approach but with no NavFace-driven scope switcher
 * (this page is Home-face-only).
 */

const PERSONAS: AgentPersona[] = [
  {
    name: 'builder',
    description: 'Watch git history and drive the next publish.',
    tools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'Bash'],
    path: '/home/bilko/.claude/agents/builder.md',
    body: 'You are the Builder agent.',
    overridingProjects: ['session-manager'],
  },
  {
    name: 'debugger',
    description: 'Diagnose a failing test.',
    tools: [],
    path: '/home/bilko/.claude/agents/debugger.md',
    body: 'You are the Debugger agent.',
    overridingProjects: [],
  },
]

function installWindowApiMock(personas: AgentPersona[] = PERSONAS) {
  const api = {
    agents: {
      listPersonas: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(personas),
    },
  }
  ;(window as unknown as { api: typeof api }).api = api
  return api
}

let container: HTMLDivElement | null = null
let root: Root | null = null

async function mount() {
  container = document.createElement('div')
  document.body.appendChild(container)
  root = createRoot(container)
  await act(async () => {
    root!.render(createElement(AgentLibrary))
    await Promise.resolve()
    await Promise.resolve()
  })
  return container
}

beforeEach(() => {
  installWindowApiMock()
})

afterEach(() => {
  act(() => root?.unmount())
  container?.remove()
  container = null
  root = null
  delete (window as unknown as { api?: unknown }).api
})

describe('AgentLibrary', () => {
  it('fetches personas on mount and lists them', async () => {
    const el = await mount()
    expect(el.textContent).toContain('builder')
    expect(el.textContent).toContain('debugger')
    expect(el.textContent).toContain('2 personas')
  })

  it('selects the first persona by default and shows its detail, incl. the overriding project (AC 6: builder overridden by session-manager)', async () => {
    const el = await mount()
    expect(el.textContent).toContain('Watch git history and drive the next publish.')
    expect(el.textContent).toContain('session-manager')
    expect(el.textContent).toContain('Read')
  })

  it('clicking another persona swaps the detail pane', async () => {
    const el = await mount()
    const debuggerRow = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('button')).find((b) => b.textContent?.includes('debugger'))
    await act(async () => {
      debuggerRow!.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }))
      await Promise.resolve()
    })
    expect(el.textContent).toContain('Diagnose a failing test.')
    expect(el.textContent).toContain('no open project overlays this agent')
  })

  it('filters the list by name', async () => {
    const el = await mount()
    const input = el.querySelector('input[placeholder="filter…"]') as HTMLInputElement
    // React tracks the input's previous value internally; setting .value via
    // plain JS before dispatching 'input' doesn't register as a change
    // unless we go through the native setter React itself overrides.
    const nativeSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value')!.set!
    await act(async () => {
      nativeSetter.call(input, 'debug')
      input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))
      await Promise.resolve()
    })
    const rowNames = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('button')).map((b) => b.textContent ?? '')
    expect(rowNames.some((t) => t.includes('debugger'))).toBe(true)
    expect(rowNames.some((t) => t.startsWith('builder'))).toBe(false)
  })
})

/**
 * Atomic write — write to <path>.tmp-<pid>-<ts> then rename. Creates parent
 * directories if missing. Cleans up the tmp file on rename failure.
 *
 * opts.mode: optional POSIX permission bits, applied to the tmp file before
 * rename. Used by voiceSettings/otelSettings for 0o600 credential storage.
 */
async function writeTextAtomic(abs, text, opts = {}) {

  validateWrite(real);
  assertOpsWrite(real, opts.writer);
  const dir = path.dirname(real);
  await fsp.mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
  const tmp = `${real}.tmp-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  try {
    await fsp.writeFile(tmp, text, opts.mode ? { encoding: 'utf8', mode: opts.mode } : 'utf8');
    if (opts.mode) {
      // chmod explicitly because some platforms ignore the mode arg on
      // writeFile when the file pre-exists.
      try { await fsp.chmod(tmp, opts.mode); } catch { /* */ }
    }
    await fsp.rename(tmp, real);
  } catch (e) {
    try { await fsp.unlink(tmp); } catch { /* tmp never created or already gone */ }
    throw e;
  }
  const stat = await fsp.stat(real);
  return { ok: true, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs };
}

/**
 * Binary-safe sibling of writeTextAtomic — same validate + tmp+rename flow,
 * for callers (screenshot capture) whose payload is a Buffer, not utf8 text.
 */
async function writeBinaryAtomic(abs, buffer, opts = {}) {
  const real = validatePath(expandHome(abs));
  validateWrite(real);
  assertOpsWrite(real, opts.writer);
  const dir = path.dirname(real);
  await fsp.mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
  const tmp = `${real}.tmp-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;

    await fsp.rename(tmp, real);
  } catch (e) {
    try { await fsp.unlink(tmp); } catch { /* tmp never created or already gone */ }
    throw e;
  }
  const stat = await fsp.stat(real);
  return { ok: true, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs };
}

async function writeJson(abs, data, opts = {}) {
  const pretty = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) + '\n';

/** Filename-safe persona name: lowercase, hyphenated, matches the `.md` files on disk. */
const PERSONA_NAME_RE = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/;

/** Serializes a persona's frontmatter + body back to `.md` file text. */
function serializePersona({ name, description, tools, model, color, body }) {
  const lines = ['---', `name: ${name}`];
  if (description) lines.push(`description: ${description}`);
  if (tools && tools.length) lines.push(`tools: ${tools.join(', ')}`);
  if (model && model !== 'inherit') lines.push(`model: ${model}`);
  if (color) lines.push(`color: ${color}`);
  lines.push('---', '');
  return lines.join('\n') + (body || '').trim() + '\n';
}

/**
 * Writes a global persona `.md` file — `~/.claude/agents/<name>.md`. Pass
 * `originalName` when renaming an existing persona so the old file is
 * removed once the new one is written (no-op if names match).
 */
async function savePersona({
  name,
  originalName,
  description,
  tools,
  model,
  color,
  body,
  globalDir = path.join(os.homedir(), '.claude', 'agents'),
  validatePath = configMgr.validatePath,
  writeTextAtomic = configMgr.writeTextAtomic,
} = {}) {
  if (!PERSONA_NAME_RE.test(name || '')) {
    throw new Error('agent name must be lowercase, hyphenated (e.g. "my-agent")');
  }
  const target = validatePath(path.join(globalDir, `${name}.md`));
  const text = serializePersona({ name, description, tools, model, color, body });
  await writeTextAtomic(target, text);
  if (originalName && originalName !== name) {
    const oldReal = validatePath(path.join(globalDir, `${originalName}.md`));

      await fsp.unlink(oldReal);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e.code !== 'ENOENT') throw e;
    }
  }
  return { ok: true, path: target };
}

  try {
    await fsp.unlink(target);
  } catch (e) {

/**
 * agentLibrary.cjs — read-only enumeration of agent personas for the
 * "Agent Library" nav page (Home face only).
 *
 * Global agent definitions live at `~/.claude/agents/*.md`. Per Claude Code's
 * own precedence rules, a project can overlay a same-named agent at
 * `<project-cwd>/.claude/agents/<name>.md`, which wins over the global
 * definition when both exist. This module reports, for every global agent,
 * which of the currently-open TABs (per sessionsStore's persisted tab list —
 * the same source of truth the renderer keeps in sync on every open/close)
 * has such an overlay.
 *
 * All filesystem paths are routed through config.cjs's validatePath so this
 * feature can't be used to read outside the home-dir boundary already
 * enforced everywhere else in the app.
 */

const fsp = require('node:fs/promises');
const fsSync = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const os = require('node:os');
const { splitFrontmatter } = require('./lib/prdFrontmatter.cjs');
const configMgr = require('./config.cjs');
const sessionsStore = require('./sessionsStore.cjs');

/** Parses the frontmatter `tools` field ("Read, Grep, Glob, Bash") into a list. */
function parseTools(raw) {
  if (!raw) return [];
  return raw.split(',').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

/**
 * Currently-open project tabs, deduped by cwd, as `{ cwd, name }` — `name`
 * is the last path segment (matches the `projectNameFromCwd` convention used
 * by the Scheduler's ProjectTag primitive). `loadSessions` is injectable
 * (mirrors scheduler.cjs's notifyOriginatingTab) so tests can exercise the
 * dedup/naming logic without touching the real persisted tabs.json.
 */
async function openProjects({ loadSessions = sessionsStore.load } = {}) {
  const { tabs } = await loadSessions();
  const seen = new Set();
  const projects = [];
  for (const t of tabs ?? []) {
    if (!t || typeof t.cwd !== 'string' || !t.cwd || seen.has(t.cwd)) continue;
    seen.add(t.cwd);
    projects.push({ cwd: t.cwd, name: path.basename(t.cwd.replace(/\/+$/, '')) || t.cwd });
  }
  return projects;
}

/**
 * Lists every global agent persona plus which open projects overlay it.
 * Deps are injectable so tests can point `globalDir` at a fixture directory
 * and `loadSessions` at a fake tab list without touching the real
 * `~/.claude/agents` or `tabs.json`.
 */
async function listPersonas({
  globalDir = path.join(os.homedir(), '.claude', 'agents'),
  loadSessions = sessionsStore.load,
  validatePath = configMgr.validatePath,
} = {}) {
  let files;
  try {
    files = (await fsp.readdir(globalDir)).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.md'));
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.code === 'ENOENT') return [];
    throw e;
  }

  const projects = await openProjects({ loadSessions });
  const personas = [];

  for (const file of files.sort()) {
    const fallbackName = file.replace(/\.md$/, '');
    let real;
    try {
      real = validatePath(path.join(globalDir, file));
    } catch {
      continue; // out of bounds — shouldn't happen for a home-relative path
    }
    let text;
    try {
      text = await fsp.readFile(real, 'utf8');
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const { fm, body } = splitFrontmatter(text);

    const overridingProjects = [];
    for (const p of projects) {
      let overlayReal;
      try {
        overlayReal = validatePath(path.join(p.cwd, '.claude', 'agents', file));
      } catch {
        continue; // project cwd outside allowed roots — skip rather than throw
      }
      if (fsSync.existsSync(overlayReal)) overridingProjects.push(p.name);
    }

    personas.push({
      name: fm.name || fallbackName,
      description: fm.description || null,
      tools: parseTools(fm.tools),
      path: real,
      body: body.trim(),
      overridingProjects,
    });
  }

  return personas;
}

module.exports = { listPersonas, openProjects, parseTools };
